title: TEST CHAMBER 14
pa: The final delivery is just within your remit.

addedBoxes.note: Plate-bay roof; underside y = 2.4 allows a generous carry clearance through the open south face. The plate is farther east than in chamber 10.
West bay wall shifts the entrance farther east, extending the carry around its south end.
East bay wall; the interior is 3.8 m wide, so no tight squeeze is required.
North bay wall closes the back; the south entrance at z = -0.9 stays open.
Staff landing at y = 3.6; underside y = 3.2 leaves the lower east door clear. Continue to z = 5 at the existing upper exit.
Privacy screen conceals the southern staircase. Its entrance is around the west end at x = 2.3.
Fix: staff bridge north to the shell catwalk at the real staff hatch (z -4.5); the high route otherwise dead-ends at the wall above the door.

solution: Possess the arm and press the button at (-6.9, 1.3, 0.65), releasing the crate and opening the staff hatch. The button itself is 6.989 m from the shoulder.
Possess the drone, fly to (8, 5.3, -6), and zap the panel at (8, 6.8, -7.5) to set override.

Possess the arm and carry the released crate at centre height y = 1.1 from (-6.2, -1.6) through these (x, z) waypoints: (2.3, -1.6), (2.3, 0.6), (5.7, 0.6), then (5.7, -2.9). This 17.6 m carry goes around the west wall and north through the bay's open south face. Set the crate down on the plate below y = 1.2; do not throw it.
With override set and the crate on the plate, possess the base and walk across the floor to the east door at z = 5.

Hidden: after the same button, override and crate sequence, take the base around the screen's west end to x = 2, z = 7.1 on the floor. Jump east along the six 1.4 m treads, gaining only 0.6 m each time. From the y = 3.6 landing, walk north to z = 5 and east through the opened staff hatch above y = 3.
